note: raw/parentA.json, parentB.json and parentC.json are the spec step’s own three launches of the parent a28c2cf3 (2026-11-25, scratch/p372/spec/out), in this probe’s raw shape: each row’s idle window filled from its cell’s own baseline (the spec step read one baseline a cell, this probe one a change), add’s counts copied as addEarly’s where the spec step counted no addEarly, every path replaced by <run>. Every HEAD launch here is one of those with its edits, written by hand, and so is every launch of the arms the spec step did not drive (E, O, R, V, S, I) and the d0002 and held-folder rows of H; its `ops` break one reading. REVIEW (2026-11-25, the probe review): every launch also carries the four fields the reviewed probe records for each launch (run, startedAt, carriesPhase, visibility), set as an honest run sets them: one run, started in the order listed, each the build it names, never hidden. The spec step’s driver recorded none of them; they are written here, never read from it.
